function.name: weather_forecast_get_prediction
function.description: Fetches the weather prediction for a specified location and date range, including temperature, precipitation chances, and wind speed. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The geographical location for which the weather forecast is requested, in the format of 'City, State' or 'City, Country', such as 'Berkeley, CA' or 'London, UK'.

start_date.description: The start date for the forecast period, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

end_date.description: The end date for the forecast period, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

units.description: The unit system used for the weather forecast results.

include_details.description: A flag indicating whether to include detailed forecast information such as hourly data.

### The “Best” Men’s Underwear Styles – What to Look For Below is a quick‑reference guide to the most common men’s underwear styles, what they’re good for, and why they’re often considered the “best” for different needs. Pick the style that matches your lifestyle, body type, and comfort preferences. | Style | Key Features | Best For | Pros | Cons | |-------|--------------|----------|------|------| | **Boxer Briefs** | Long‑leg, snug fit; full coverage; elastic waistband | Everyday wear, sports, travel | • Good support, minimal bunching
• Versatile for all body types | • Can feel restrictive for some
• May show seams under tight pants | | **Briefs (Classic)** | Short leg, snug fit; waistband at hips | Work, casual, gym | • Excellent support
• Minimal visible lines | • Limited coverage; may feel tight for larger thighs | | **Trunks** | Shorter leg than briefs, snug fit; waistband at hips | Modern look, athletic wear | • Sleek profile, less bulk
• Good for low‑cut pants | • Less coverage; may not suit larger thighs | | **Boxers** | Loose fit, short leg; elastic waistband | Relaxed, sleepwear, lounging | • Breathable, airy
• No compression | • Can bunch up; visible panty lines | | **Compression Briefs** | Tight, supportive fabric; often with moisture‑wicking | Athletes, long flights, active wear | • Keeps everything in place
• Moisture control | • Can feel too tight for extended wear | | **Performance/Tech Underwear** | Moisture‑wicking, anti‑odor, quick‑dry | Outdoor activities, travel | • Keeps dry, reduces odor
• Lightweight | • Usually pricier; may lack style | | **Bamboo/Organic Cotton** | Natural fibers; soft, breathable | Sensitive skin, eco‑friendly | • Hypoallergenic, sustainable
• Soft feel | • Can be pricier; may shrink | | **Lace/Designer** | Decorative fabrics; often more feminine | Special occasions, gifts | • Stylish, unique | • Not practical for everyday use | --- #### How to Choose the Right Style 1. **Consider Your Activity Level** - *Low activity*: Boxers or loose briefs for breathability. - *High activity*: Compression briefs or performance fabrics to keep moisture away. 2. **Think About Your Body Shape** - *Thick thighs*: Boxers or longer briefs to avoid tightness. - *Slim build*: Trunks or briefs for a sleek look. 3. **Look at the Fabric** - *Cotton*: Soft but can absorb sweat. - *Microfiber/Merino wool*: Moisture‑wicking, odor‑resistant. - *Bamboo*: Eco‑friendly, naturally antibacterial. 4. **Fit Matters** - A snug waistband should stay in place without digging into the skin. - The leg cut should match your pant style (e.g., trunks for low‑cut jeans). 5. **Durability & Care** - Check washing instructions; some performance fabrics need cold water only. - Look for reinforced stitching at the waistband and seams. --- #### Quick Recommendations | Need | Suggested Style | Why | |------|-----------------|-----| | **Everyday office wear** | Boxer briefs (mid‑rise) | Comfortable, no visible lines under slacks. | | **Gym / running** | Compression briefs or performance briefs | Keeps everything in place, wicks sweat. | | **Travel** | Performance briefs + a pair of boxers | Mix of support and breathability. | | **Summer heat** | Boxers or loose briefs in bamboo | Airflow, natural fibers keep cool. | | **Special occasion** | Designer briefs or a silk boxer | Adds a touch of luxury. | --- #### Final Thought There isn’t a single “best” style for everyone—comfort is subjective. Try a few different cuts and fabrics to see what feels right for you. If you’re still unsure, many brands offer sample packs or return policies so you can test before committing. Happy underwear hunting!
